newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SACCHI RETURNS TO SEE MILAN GO OUT OF EUROPEAN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SACCHI RETURNS TO SEE MILAN GO OUT OF EUROPEAN CUP.

text.p: Arrigo Sacchi, who twice won the European Cup as coach of AC Milan, returned on Wednesday to watch the Italian club go out of this season's competition after a nightmare 2-1 defeat to Norway's Rosenborg.

The Group D match was Sacchi's first since he resigned as Italian national coach on Sunday night to return to Milan and he was spared nothing by opponents who had been beaten 4-1 by Milan at home but who twice took the lead at San Siro.

Milan, with striker George Weah suspended, came into the game only a point clear of Rosenborg and needed a draw to go through. They soon found themselves needing a goal to stay alive after Harald Brattbakk hit a left-footed shot past Sebastiano Rossi in the 29th minute.

French international Christophe Dugarry equalised well into injury time in the first half and Milan looked like hanging on for the precious point until Vegard Heggem struck in the 69th, sending the Norwegians through with Portugal's Porto.
